name: hold-button
title: Hold Button
description: Press-and-hold button for risky actions. A fill tracks progress, releasing early cancels, and a complete event fires.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style, the same set as Button.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32, 40, or 48px, the same as Button.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the button must be held, in milliseconds.

props.name: onComplete / @complete / x-on:complete
props.description: Fires once the hold reaches the full duration. Blade dispatches a complete DOM event.

a11y: Holding Space or Enter works like holding the pointer, releasing the key cancels.
holdLabel is linked with aria-describedby so screen readers explain the gesture.
The state is exposed as data-state idle, holding, or complete.
The progress fill keeps running with reduced motion because it carries meaning, it is a linear fill without movement.

ai.whenToUse: Confirming a destructive or costly action without opening a dialog, such as delete, publish, or transfer.
rules: Run the action in onComplete, not in onClick
Say hold in the label, for example Hold to delete

id.description: Tombol tekan dan tahan untuk aksi berisiko. Isian menunjukkan progres, lepas lebih awal membatalkan, lalu event complete dipicu.

props.duration: Lama tombol harus ditahan, dalam milidetik.
props.holdLabel: Petunjuk tersembunyi yang ditautkan lewat aria-describedby.
props.onComplete / @complete / x-on:complete: Dipicu saat tahanan mencapai durasi penuh. Blade mengirim event DOM complete.

a11y: Menahan Spasi atau Enter sama seperti menahan pointer, melepas tombol membatalkan.
holdLabel ditautkan lewat aria-describedby agar screen reader menjelaskan cara memakainya.
Keadaan tersedia sebagai data-state idle, holding, atau complete.
Isian progres tetap berjalan saat reduced motion karena membawa makna, berupa isian linear tanpa gerakan.

ai.whenToUse: Mengonfirmasi aksi yang merusak atau mahal tanpa membuka dialog, seperti hapus, terbitkan, atau transfer.
rules: Jalankan aksi di onComplete, bukan di onClick
Sebut tahan di label, misalnya Hold to delete
